Location: Kitimat, BC, Canada
Description:

Experienced Masters are sought for command of escort and harbour tugs operating in Canadian waters. The role involves full responsibility for safe and efficient vessel operation, including navigation, crew management, and emergency response, ensuring compliance with regulations. Requirements include Master 3000 Domestic (or higher) for Escort Tugs, or Master 500 Domestic (or higher) for Harbour Tugs, and previous experience on ASD tugs. Strong leadership and decision-making skills are essential.

Location: Tanzania, Mwanza
Description:

A Marine Deck Officer is sought for vessel operations on Lake Victoria in Mwanza, Tanzania. This role is crucial for ensuring safe navigation and efficient deck operations, adhering to all maritime regulations. The position requires a valid CoC II/1, STCW certificates, and proven experience as a Deck Officer, preferably on inland waters. Responsibilities include supervising loading/unloading, vessel maintenance, and collaborative crew work. A valid medical fitness certificate is mandatory.
